title: Extension of a quasi-coherent open section from an ideal power
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf represented by ideal-sheaf data [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $U$ an open with $V(I)=X\setminus U$. For every section $s\in E(U)$, there exist $n\geq0$ and $\alpha:I^n\to E$ such that for every open $W\subseteq U$ and $a\in I^n(W)$, $\alpha_W(a)=a\,s|_W$, using the canonical inclusion $I^n\to\mathcal O_X$ and ideal-sheaf-data powers (the zeroth power is the unit ideal) [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk].

source.place: Tag 01YB (coherent-lemma-homs-over-open), structure-module case and internal-Hom/tensor-Hom paragraphs before the kernel argument.

proof.text: Choose a quasi-coherent submodule G of E carrying s as t, with every ideal-power annihilator zero.

Identify the ideal complement with U using the affine stalk-surjectivity criterion. Its recursive powers are bijective on sections inside U; take the unique lifts one(n) of 1. Factor higher recursive inclusions through lower ones by induction. The ideal is finite type because X is Noetherian.

Apply the torsion-free lifting statement to G and t. Its zero-annihilator hypothesis is exactly the carrier condition; it yields psi:P_n -> G with psi_U(one(n))=t. No annihilator quotients or zero-object kernel argument is needed.

Precompose psi with the ideal-data/recursive power comparison and compose with g. On W contained in U, restrict one(n) to o. Naturality sends o to 1 in the structure ring and psi(o) to t restricted to W. Injectivity of the recursive inclusion shows e(a)=a o. Linearity and naturality of g yield alpha_W(a)=a s restricted to W.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01YB, structure-module argument, using the torsion-free case of Tags 01PM and 01PQ through ideal_power_torsionFree_section_lifting. The all-opens scalar formula is proved by naturality and linearity. Repairs the quotient-lifting import cycle.

theorem quasicoherent_open_section_ideal_extension
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.Opens)
    (hI : (I.support : Set X) = (U : Set X)ᶜ) (s : E.val.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (α : (I ^ n).toModules ⟶ E),
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ U) (a : (I ^ n).toModules.val.obj (op W)),
        α.val.app (op W) a =
          (I ^ n).toModulesι.val.app (op W) a • E.val.map (homOfLE h).op s
